name: Donut chart
purpose: Composition / proportion as a ring with a centre total — the round-one dataviz kit's donut graduated into canon, FULL LAYER-2 restored (chart-revisit wave lane ②, 2026-07-24, exemplar pattern): segment popover · table-view popover · legend-as-filter/isolate/highlight · value ⇄ % segmented toggle (baked variant groups) · optional title + H-stack head · high-contrast remap. PROVISIONAL-AGENT: promoted from the PARKED kit (9 review rounds, not signed off); ring geometry and both labelling variants are OBSERVED kit values.
when: answers=composition AND parts sum to a whole AND total=printed as a centre figure — beats chart-pie (48, "composition, no centre figure, ≤ 5 parts") whenever the total is worth printing, and beats it on nothing else; yields to chart-stacked-area (64, "composition over time") when the split MOVES.

props.name: labelling
props.$note: spider = letter on a short leader outside the ring + vertical legend [swatch][letter][name]; direct = name + value in place, no legend (its own colour-independent channel). The kit's third variant — letters ON segments — is NOT promoted: white letters on series fills collide with type26-013 white-type-red-only; Dave's Batch-2 #7 comparison stays open (receipted).

props.name: slices
props.$note: Maximum 6 (dv-pie-009); more → combine smallest into 'Other'. Values must sum to the displayed centre total (dv-pie-010, data-total attr).

props.name: total
props.$note: Centre total — .t-cm-figure-3 (24px/500; kit's 22px promoted to the ramp step, DV-D05).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

props.name: valueMode
props.$note: Menu item 5 (ruled in): the Segmented-control atom (.seg.sm) drives BAKED variant groups (data-dv-view) — centre total, direct labels AND the table column mirror the active mode. JS-off = value view. Tips/aria carry both readings always.

props.name: title
props.$note: Optional visible title (.dv-title, t-cm-section-label) in the H-stack head; sr-only figcaption still names the chart when absent.

variants.name: spider + legend
variants.use: Default composition view; letters bridge chart ↔ legend (§04.3).

variants.name: direct labels
variants.use: Self-contained view (print/export-friendly); name + £value · % on each leader.

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

separation.value: stroke = background/default (page) at 2px on every segment

tokens.labels: text/default (ink) — spider letters and direct labels never sit ON the fills
tokens.$survey: Promoted from _proforma/DataViz-interactive.html (PARKED, fence intact). Direct value line weight: kit 600 → 500 (no 600 on brand — receipted correction).

motion.entry: RADIAL SWEEP RETURNS (ADR-0015: data-driven geometry is JS territory) — segments bake the sweep contract (data-cx/-cy/-ro/-ri/-a1/-a2) + data-seq on annotations; the rAF sweep hook itself is a dv-behaviour source edit = CONDUCTOR'S SERIAL (proposed code in the lane-② receipt; source is ~1.7KB from its 16KB cap — per-capability split observed). Baked state = full arcs + visible annotations, so JS-off / reduced-motion / pre-hook all render complete.
motion.hover: brightness(1.12/1.22) emphasis + dvTip popover (data-tip; replaces native <title>) + legend/segment highlight dims the OTHER groups (.dv-quiet, data layer only).
motion.reducedMotion: Global collapse present (only hover transitions exist).

responsive.rule: DV-D02 excluded donuts from width-compression (compressing a circle distorts) — fixed geometry; .dv-stage scrolls if the container is narrower.

behaviour.fallback: With CSS on and JS off the spider/legend canvas renders as an EMPTY <svg> and no ring is drawn — dvRender is what fills it. The data is not lost and is not unlabelled: the figure carries a real <table class="dv-table"> inside a native <details>/<summary> disclosure (s116-D2), authored in the markup and not generated, so the five categories, their pounds and their percentage shares open and read with no script at all (dv-005 tabular alternative + the a11y spine). The engine REWRITES those same rows from the spec when it runs, so the popover value and the table value are one number by construction. The DIRECT-LABEL canvas stays baked, so a complete ring, its leaders, its in-place labels and its centre total all render with JS off. Lost with JS off: the DV-D12 radial sweep intro, the value popover, the DV-D11 legend filter/isolate, the DV-D13 centre-follows-selection readout, the value ⇄ percent toggle and Copy CSV.
behaviour.$note: Typed s249-D4 / #259 (the donut type lane). `script` addresses the ENGINE CORE — dv-render.js is where this component's behaviour begins; dv-render-donut.js is reached through its type registry and is named in `partial`. `partial` lists ALL FIVE registered AUTO-BEHAVIOUR names the snippet actually carries, which is the schema's own wording ('the AUTO-BEHAVIOUR name(s) … that the snippet carries') and the s245-D2 shape for a member carrying 2–3+; chart-bar.meta.json lists three of its four and flagged the discrepancy at #259 lane A. ⛔ THE INJECTION ORDER ON THE SNIPPET IS NOT THE REGISTRY ORDER: dv-render and dv-render-donut sit ABOVE the dvRender() bootstrap and dv-legend + dv-donut-sweep BELOW it, because both of those initialise at parse time against marks that do not exist until the engine has drawn them.

mustNotNeighbour: A second composition chart of the same data (pick one)
Charts re-using these series colours for different data (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="img", aria-label carries subject + total.
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; every segment carries aria-label == data-tip == table (name, value, percentage — one source); the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Segments = focus stops (tabindex 0 → dvTip on focus); legend rows = buttons (Enter toggles, Shift+Enter isolates); seg view switch + CSV + table dropdown all native buttons; table panel takes focus on open, Esc returns it.
accessibility.focus: 2px ink outline on segments/buttons/panel (focus-visible); seg buttons inset −2.
accessibility.nonText: Segment fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes; identity = letter/name + position + table, never colour alone (1.4.1); 2px page strokes keep adjacent segments separable.

antiPatterns: Segment values that don't sum to the centre total (dv-pie-010)
Gapless segments without the 2px page stroke (dv-004)
White letters on segment fills (type26-013 — white type is red-only; label in ink outside the ring)
A donut without its real data table (dv-005)
Proportionally scaling the ring down (DV-D02 donut exclusion — it distorts)
Signalling a control's off state by dimming alone (ADR-0014 inactive ≠ disabled — the legend off-state is the hollow-swatch + data/axis grey recipe)
Recomputing arc geometry at runtime outside the sweep hook (geometry is generation-time; behaviour only toggles baked variants)

tokenValidation.result: PASS — series 1–5 ≥3.31:1 both modes (+ HC 1–5 declared); ink 17.4:1; data/axis 6.10/6.42:1 (off-state text floor); sum 2320 = data-total; 5 slices; arc↔table parity scripted incl. the % column.
tokenValidation.$note: Layer-2 restored chart-revisit wave lane ② (2026-07-24) on the exemplar pattern. PROVISIONAL-AGENT pending Dave's dataviz sign-off. D-Q2 (spider vs direct default) OPEN — not picked; letters-on-segments HELD (type26-013). Filtering hides segments IN PLACE (honest gap); centre total stays the FULL total (receipted). Registration in component-types.json + dv-behaviour injection + sweep hook = conductor's serial. No progress-ring variant — the kit has none; the loader atom stays queued (§C·4b).

slices.use: The parts of the whole drawn as ring segments.
slices.$status: ruled s140-D2 (Dave, 2026-08-09, via SLOTS-DRAFT-REVIEW s140-v1 export)

obeys.$why: Start at 12 o'clock and order slices largest to smallest unless the categories carry their own order: the angles are fixed at generation time here - segments bake the sweep contract (data-cx/-cy/-ro/-ri/-a1/-a2) - and the antiPattern against recomputing arc geometry at runtime is what keeps that order from drifting.

Label plus exact proportional value on every slice, indicator lines where segments crowd, a key when the labels are letters: the meta's default `labelling` = spider is all three at once - a letter on a short leader outside the ring plus a vertical legend of swatch, letter and name - the leader IS the indicator line and the legend IS the key.

The centre must carry the total value AND its descriptor, never a descriptor without the value: this is the only component in the family with a `total` prop - the centre total typed .t-cm-figure-3 - and its `when` makes that printed centre figure the very thing that beats chart-pie. The rule binds here and nowhere else (s277-D2).
Direct labelling adjacent to segments is this meta's second declared variant: name + value + % on each leader, in place, rather than in a legend across the card.

Labels sit inside a slice only where they stay readable, and this meta answers by taking them off the fills entirely - spider letters and direct labels never sit ON the fills - with the kit's letters-on-segments variant HELD rather than promoted, for the same reason.

The direction slices are ordered in must be checked against assistive technology, and this meta makes that order audible: segments are focus stops that raise dvTip on focus, and every segment's aria-label == data-tip == table, so the sweep order IS the reading order.

Never enlarge or pull out a slice for emphasis: this meta has no exploded variant and structurally cannot grow one - geometry is generation-time; behaviour only toggles baked variants - and its emphasis channel is a brightness lift that dims the OTHER groups, not displacement.

A ring shows a part's size relative to the whole and never compares one group to another: this meta's `when` demands answers=composition AND parts sum to a whole, which is the rule's usage gate stated from the routing side.

Maximum 6 slices for pie and doughnut alike: the meta's `slices` prop cites this rule by id and carries its remedy - more, and the smallest combine into 'Other' - and the antiPatterns repeat it, so the edge records a binding the file already states twice.

Values must add up to the total, and the value indicators must be there: here the total is ON SCREEN, so the arithmetic is checkable by eye - values must sum to the displayed centre total (dv-pie-010, data-total attr) - and tokenValidation records the measured proof, sum 2320 = data-total.

Always indicate when values are rounded: the percent arm of this meta's `valueMode` is where rounded readings appear, and the meta's answer is that the exact one is never lost - tips/aria carry both readings always, and the centre total, the direct labels and the table column all mirror the active mode together.
